preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x < y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (x, y) connects distinct vertices x and y within the range [1, n].
The input contains exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree.
The edges form a connected undirected graph (tree).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers, one for each vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= dominant_index <= max_depth for dominant_index in output)
postconditions.description: Each dominant index is a non-negative integer not exceeding the maximum depth of the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(dominant_index == find_dominant_index(vertex, tree) for vertex, dominant_index in enumerate(output, start=1))
postconditions.description: For each vertex i, the output dominant index matches the computed dominant index based on its depth array.
